# Complete parameters for bases (-2, 3)

This file is generated by `export_parameters.py` from the sole parameter source, `parameters.py`. Every table is complete, with no omitted rows. It records choices to be verified, not computation results or a record of successful verification.

The internal and paper targets agree for this case. The main verification requires the computed lower bound to exceed this value strictly.

The terminal construction uses the integer window `[-300000000, 300000000]`. Paths leaving the window may be discarded, so the resulting count is a lower bound.
